_meta.purpose: Control plane for the 9-capability contract. One row per machine-readable artifact in the repo. Single audit point. Per ADR-0015 registry pattern + AWS-Config / GCP-Asset-Inventory / K8s-CRD precedent.
_meta.baseline_audit_scope: First-batch rows: (a) the contract schema itself, (b) 5 existing canonical /specs/cross-cutting/*, (c) evidence-bundle-template, (d) 3 ops-portal artifacts just authored. Remaining repo artifacts to be added incrementally per migration policy registry. Self-update lane scans applicable_paths_glob nightly + adds rows for new artifacts.
_meta.profile_system: Per architect r17 fix #8: each row uses artifact_profile + capability_overrides instead of full 9-capability boilerplate. Profile defaults live at /specs/cross-cutting/artifact-profile-defaults.json. Validator merges profile_defaults[<row.artifact_profile>].default_capabilities + row.capability_overrides to produce the resolved declaration.

Canonical EvidenceBundle schema. Lifts Phase-00 evidence shape. Enforced via oya-foundry-fitness-audit-emission.

Plan-acceptance attestation for ops.oyatie.com Wave 5 v18 consensus close. Records honest-gap-acknowledgement for missing cosign/rekor/audit-chain.
Machine-readable µservice registry per ADR-0056 BNF v4.1 + ADR-0058 flat catalog. Wave 1 IP-X1 catalog-prelude entry.
Machine-readable BC registry per ADR-0015 flat-crates. Wave 1 IP-X1 catalog-prelude entry (2 ops BCs).
Cargo manifest for first ops Wave 1 kernel crate (SurfaceCatalogPort + InMemorySurfaceCatalog + types). std-only kernel layer per ADR-0015.
Cargo manifest for ops Wave 1 docs-portal kernel (ManifestPort + LiveFeedPort + ExtractorClass hot/warm/cold per ADR-0066). std-only.
OpenAPI 3.2 contract for ops workspace shell BC. Consumes oya-ops-workspace-shell-kernel types (SurfaceCatalogPort + SurfaceState + VisibilityTier). Cedar-gated; ADR-0067 perf authority.
OpenAPI 3.2 contract for ops docs-portal BC. Consumes oya-ops-docs-portal-kernel types (ManifestPort + LiveFeedPort + ExtractorClass hot/warm/cold per ADR-0066). SSE p99 ≤2s.
Catalog of 7 Cedar policy fragments referenced by ops OpenAPI contracts. Drift gate: every cedar_fragments[] reference must resolve here; every Cedar file on disk must appear here.
Cargo manifest for the cedar-fragment-coverage check kernel (std-only). Validates C01-C04 invariants from cedar-fragments-registry. Backs lean-a-cedar-fragment-coverage lane.
Cargo manifest for ops Wave 1 workspace-shell adapter (std-only). Projects kernel Surface types onto OpenAPI 3.2 wire schema in contracts/ops-workspace-shell-v1.openapi.yaml.
Cargo manifest for ops Wave 1 docs-portal adapter (std-only). Projects kernel ManifestSnapshot + LiveFeedEvent + ExtractorRecord onto OpenAPI 3.2 wire schema in contracts/ops-docs-v1.openapi.yaml.

Cargo manifest for ops Wave 1 workspace-shell application crate (std-only). Orchestration layer: use cases (ListLive/ListAll/Register/FlipState/Health) compose kernel SurfaceCatalogPort + adapter wire DTOs.
Cargo manifest for ops Wave 1 docs-portal application crate (std-only). Use cases: GetManifest, RefreshExtractor (composite: refresh + emit live-feed), RegisterExtractor, SubscribeLiveFeed.

Cargo manifest for ops Wave 1 workspace-shell rest crate (std-only; framework-free). REST boundary types + handler functions; routes 1:1 with contracts/ops-workspace-shell-v1.openapi.yaml. Axum binding deferred to runtime composition root per LTS-dependency-enforcement directive.
Cargo manifest for ops Wave 1 docs-portal rest crate (std-only). REST boundary for /workspace/docs/{manifest, live, api/v1/extractors/{id}/refresh}. Framework binding deferred.

Cargo manifest for Foundry architecture-map kernel (std-only graph model) per visualization-as-code directive 2026-05-12. Node/Edge taxonomy: Microservice|BC|Crate|OpenApi|CedarFragment|Lane × contains|exposes|governs|depends-on|enforces.
Cargo manifest for openapi-rest-route-parity check kernel (std-only). Compares REST _ROUTE constants vs OpenAPI paths sets. Backs lean-a-openapi-rest-route-parity lane (active in scripts/check.sh).

Cargo manifest for foundry architecture-map app crate (std-only). Walks workspace Cargo.toml + /registries/cross-cutting/* + contracts/ and emits architecture-map.json. Visualization-as-code directive 2026-05-12. No external deps beyond the kernel.

Emitted architecture map JSON. Sources: workspace Cargo.toml + /registries/cross-cutting/microservices.json + bounded-contexts.json + cedar-fragments.json + contracts/*.openapi.yaml. Refreshed via `oya gate emit architecture-map`.
Hyper foundation Layer 1: std-only path-template router (HttpMethod + RouteTemplate + Router<H>). Per hyper-backbone directive 2026-05-14. No external deps.
Hyper foundation Layer 2: std-only Middleware trait + MiddlewareChain composer with Next<'_> chain handler. Sync semantics; async wrap lives in Layer 5 hyper adapter.
Hyper foundation Layer 3: SSE event framing (id/event/data/retry + heartbeat). text/event-stream per WHATWG SSE spec. Std-only.

Hyper foundation Layer 5: THE ONLY crate importing hyper directly per ADR-0090. Bridges Router + MiddlewareChain → hyper::service::Service. Deps: hyper 1, hyper-util 0.1, tokio 1, http-body-util 0.1, bytes 1.
ADR declaring hyper 1.x as workspace HTTP backbone per user directive 2026-05-14. LTS-exception with version pins for hyper/hyper-util/tokio/http-body-util/bytes.

Layer 6 composition root for the ops/workspace BC. Hyper binary `oya-ops-workspace-shell` listens on 127.0.0.1:OYATIE_OPS_WORKSPACE_PORT (default 8080). Wires kernel → application → rest → router-kernel → middleware-kernel → runtime-hyper-adapter into a single tokio::main. Per ADR-0090.
Layer 4 middleware: x-tenant-id header extraction + validation (alphanumeric + dash + underscore; ≤128 chars); deny-on-missing/invalid with 400.
Layer 4 middleware: per-request budget timer; replaces response with 504 when elapsed exceeds budget_ms. Std-only; sync (post-hoc enforcement).
Layer 4 middleware: per-(method, route, status_class) counter + total_latency_us aggregator. In-memory sink; OTel exporter is a separate slice.
Detailed goal prompt artifact for autonomous implementation of the Oyatie master plan, with RALPLAN-style review metadata.
